ac_outdoor_unit_large.name: ac_outdoor_unit_large
ac_outdoor_unit_large.desc: Japanese split air-conditioner outdoor unit 0.95 x 1.3 x 0.35 m
notes: Pipes rise behind the right side to the wall plane (Unity z = -0.24); place the unit with its back ~0.07 m from a wall.

ac_outdoor_unit_small.name: ac_outdoor_unit_small
ac_outdoor_unit_small.desc: Japanese split air-conditioner outdoor unit 0.8 x 0.55 x 0.29 m
notes: Pipes rise behind the right side to the wall plane (Unity z = -0.21); place the unit with its back ~0.07 m from a wall.

akachochin_single.name: akachochin_single
akachochin_single.desc: Large izakaya red lantern (赤提灯, Φ0.36 x 0.6 m) on a wall bracket
akachochin_single.origin: wall plane at the bracket (mount ~2.4 m)
notes: LightAnchor_0 = lantern centre. Text faces Unity +Z (front 焼鳥, back 酒).

bench.name: bench
bench.desc: Japanese street/park bench 1.8 m: cast frames, wooden slats, centre armrest

bicycle.name: bicycle
bicycle.desc: Japanese city bike (mamachari) on its two-leg stand, 26" wheels
bicycle.origin: ground, midway between the wheel contact points

bollard_steel.name: bollard_steel
bollard_steel.desc: Stainless round bollard (車止め) Φ114 x 0.85 m with yellow reflective bands

bollard_u.name: bollard_u
bollard_u.desc: U-shaped arch bollard (アーチ型車止め), Φ60.5 pipe, 0.8 x 0.8 m, yellow
bollard_u.front: faces Unity +Z (pipe plane is Unity XY)

bus_stop_pole.name: bus_stop_pole
bus_stop_pole.desc: Tokyo city-bus stop pole (都営バス style): weighted round base, Φ60.5 pole, double-sided round sign Φ0.5 (M_SignFace, both sides 0-1 UV), timetable case (M_SignFace_Aux)
bus_stop_pole.front: sign faces Unity +Z and -Z; timetable faces Unity +Z
notes: Round sign face UV 0-1 (1:1) on both sides; timetable M_SignFace_Aux UV 0-1 (0.33 x 0.50).

chochin_string_4m.name: chochin_string_4m
chochin_string_4m.desc: Festival red paper lanterns (祭り提灯) on a rope, 4 m tile with 5 lanterns
chochin_string_4m.origin: rope start (Unity X=0); rope along Unity X 0..4 at y=0; lanterns hang below
notes: Tile: chain at Unity X += 4. LightAnchor_0..4 = lantern centres (optional warm point lights). Body texture wraps cylindrically (u=0.5 faces Unity +Z).

coin_parking_sign.name: coin_parking_sign
coin_parking_sign.desc: Coin-parking "P" lightbox sign 0.9 x 0.9 m on a 3.3 m square post (fictional operator), double-sided, emissive face

cone_bar_2m.name: cone_bar_2m
cone_bar_2m.desc: Yellow/black cone bar 2 m, end rings slip over traffic_cone tips (cones at X=0 and X=2)
cone_bar_2m.origin: ground under the first cone centre (Unity X=0)

construction_barrier.name: construction_barrier
construction_barrier.desc: Japanese A-type folding barricade 1.2 x 0.8 m, yellow/black striped boards both sides, red LED blinker on top
notes: M_EmissiveSignal_Red dome = blinking warning lamp (animate emission in Unity).

convex_traffic_mirror.name: convex_traffic_mirror
convex_traffic_mirror.desc: Japanese road curve mirror (カーブミラー), orange 76.3 mm post, Φ800 convex mirror
convex_traffic_mirror.front: mirror faces Unity +Z, tilted 6 deg down

convex_traffic_mirror_double.name: convex_traffic_mirror_double
convex_traffic_mirror_double.desc: Japanese road curve mirror (カーブミラー), orange 76.3 mm post, two Φ800 convex mirrors on a T bracket
convex_traffic_mirror_double.front: mirror faces Unity +Z, tilted 6 deg down

drain_grating_1m.name: drain_grating_1m
drain_grating_1m.desc: Steel road-gutter grating (グレーチング) 1.0 x 0.40 m over a U-gutter, flush with the road
drain_grating_1m.origin: road surface at the start of the gutter centre-line; tile spans Unity X 0..1

fire_hydrant_sign.name: fire_hydrant_sign
fire_hydrant_sign.desc: Tokyo-style fire hydrant sign: red 消火栓 board 0.4 x 0.8 m on a Φ60.5 post, top at 3.25 m

garbage_cage.name: garbage_cage
garbage_cage.desc: Garbage collection station: folding steel mesh cage 1.2 x 0.7 x 0.9 m
notes: M_WireMesh_Cutout = alpha-cutout (double-sided thin panels); needs a cutout toon material.

guardrail_end_finish.name: guardrail_end_finish
guardrail_end_finish.desc: W-beam guardrail end wing (袖ビーム) curving away from the road + end post

guardrail_end_start.name: guardrail_end_start
guardrail_end_start.desc: W-beam guardrail end wing (袖ビーム) curving away from the road

guardrail_wbeam_4m.name: guardrail_wbeam_4m
guardrail_wbeam_4m.desc: Japanese W-beam guardrail tile, 4 m, white, round posts every 2 m (posts at X=0 and X=2)
guardrail_wbeam_4m.origin: ground, at the start post centre (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..4
notes: Tile: posts at Unity X=0 and X=2; next tile starts at X=4. Close a run with guardrail_end_finish at X=4N and guardrail_end_start at X=0.

hokora_small.name: hokora_small
hokora_small.desc: Small roadside shrine (祠): stone base, wooden body with lattice doors, copper gabled roof, chigi/katsuogi, mini shimenawa

kerb_stone_1m.name: kerb_stone_1m
kerb_stone_1m.desc: Japanese road/sidewalk boundary kerb block (歩車道境界ブロック), 1.0 m, 180/205 x 250, 150 mm exposed
kerb_stone_1m.origin: road surface level at the road-side face, start of block; tile 0..1 in Unity X; block extends 0.1 m below road and toward -Z (sidewalk side)

manhole_cover.name: manhole_cover
manhole_cover.desc: Tokyo-style decorative sewer manhole cover Φ0.6 m in a Φ0.72 frame, 6 mm proud of the road
notes: Top disc UV 0-1 over the lid; M_Deco_Manhole has albedo + normal map.

manhole_cover_hydrant.name: manhole_cover_hydrant
manhole_cover_hydrant.desc: Yellow-painted fire hydrant lid (消火栓) Φ0.6 m in a Φ0.72 frame, 6 mm proud
notes: Text reads correctly when viewed from Unity +Z looking toward -Z (rotate in Y as needed).

noren_curtain.name: noren_curtain
noren_curtain.desc: Shop entrance noren: 1.8 m rod, 4 indigo panels (0.42 x 0.9 m) らーめん
noren_curtain.origin: wall plane under the rod centre, at rod height (~2.0 m)
notes: M_Deco_Noren UV: planar 0-1 over the whole curtain (u right, v up, from the front); swap texture for other shop names.

pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_green.name: pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_green
pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_green.desc: Tokyo sidewalk pedestrian railing, bars style, green, 2 m tile (post at X=0)
pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_green.origin: ground at the start post (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..2
notes: Tile has its post at X=0 only; finish a run with pedestrian_railing_endpost_<colour> at X=2N.

pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_white.name: pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_white
pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_white.desc: Tokyo sidewalk pedestrian railing, bars style, white, 2 m tile (post at X=0)
pedestrian_railing_2m_bars_white.origin: ground at the start post (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..2
notes: Tile has its post at X=0 only; finish a run with pedestrian_railing_endpost_<colour> at X=2N.

pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_green.name: pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_green
pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_green.desc: Tokyo sidewalk pedestrian railing, pipe style, green, 2 m tile (post at X=0)
pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_green.origin: ground at the start post (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..2
notes: Tile has its post at X=0 only; finish a run with pedestrian_railing_endpost_<colour> at X=2N.

pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_white.name: pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_white
pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_white.desc: Tokyo sidewalk pedestrian railing, pipe style, white, 2 m tile (post at X=0)
pedestrian_railing_2m_pipe_white.origin: ground at the start post (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..2
notes: Tile has its post at X=0 only; finish a run with pedestrian_railing_endpost_<colour> at X=2N.

pedestrian_railing_endpost_green.name: pedestrian_railing_endpost_green
pedestrian_railing_endpost_green.desc: End post closing a pedestrian railing run (green)

pedestrian_railing_endpost_white.name: pedestrian_railing_endpost_white
pedestrian_railing_endpost_white.desc: End post closing a pedestrian railing run (white)

post_box_round.name: post_box_round
post_box_round.desc: Classic Japanese round red post box (丸型ポスト), 1.36 m

post_box_square.name: post_box_square
post_box_square.desc: Modern Japanese square red post box on a pedestal, two slots

post_cone.name: post_cone
post_cone.desc: Japanese flexible delineator post (ポストコーン), 80 mm x 0.8 m, orange/white

road_sign_post_diamond.name: road_sign_post_diamond
road_sign_post_diamond.desc: Warning sign (diamond, 0.45 m side), blank M_SignFace
notes: M_SignFace UV 0-1 = bounding square 0.636 x 0.636.

road_sign_post_rect.name: road_sign_post_rect
road_sign_post_rect.desc: Rectangular sign panel 0.9 x 0.6 m, blank M_SignFace
notes: M_SignFace UV 0-1 over 0.90 x 0.60 (3:2).

road_sign_post_round.name: road_sign_post_round
road_sign_post_round.desc: Round regulatory sign Φ0.6 m (blank, M_SignFace) + auxiliary plate 0.6 x 0.25 (M_SignFace_Aux) on a Φ60.5 galvanized post
notes: M_SignFace UV 0-1 = bounding square of the disc (1:1). M_SignFace_Aux UV 0-1 over the 0.60 x 0.25 plate (2.4:1).

road_sign_post_triangle.name: road_sign_post_triangle
road_sign_post_triangle.desc: Inverted triangle sign (止まれ type), side 0.8 m, blank M_SignFace
notes: M_SignFace UV 0-1 = bounding box 0.80 x 0.69 (point down).

rooftop_billboard_frame.name: rooftop_billboard_frame
rooftop_billboard_frame.desc: Rooftop advertising tower (屋上広告塔): 10 x 5 m board on raking steel lattice, catwalk + floodlights
rooftop_billboard_frame.origin: roof surface, centre of the board foot line
notes: M_BillboardFace: one quad 10 x 5 m, UV 0-1 (2:1, u right, v up). LightAnchor_0..4 = floodlight emitters (aim spot lights toward Unity -Z and down at the face).

rooftop_water_tank.name: rooftop_water_tank
rooftop_water_tank.desc: FRP sectional panel water tank (受水槽) 3 x 2 x 2 m on steel base

saisen_box.name: saisen_box
saisen_box.desc: Wooden offering box (賽銭箱) 0.94 x 0.58 x 0.6 m, slatted top, brass corner fittings, 賽銭 front plate

shop_awning_dome.name: shop_awning_dome
shop_awning_dome.desc: Quarter-round (R-type) canvas shop awning 2.5 m wide, 0.9 m projection, green/white stripes
shop_awning_dome.origin: wall plane, top-centre attach line (mount ~2.8 m above pavement)
notes: Stripe texture repeats every 0.5 m across the width (UV.box s=0.5, tileable).

shop_awning_flat.name: shop_awning_flat
shop_awning_flat.desc: Fixed sloped canvas shop awning 3.0 x 1.2 m with valance + side wings, red/white stripes
shop_awning_flat.origin: wall plane, top-centre attach line (mount ~2.6 m above pavement)
notes: Stripe texture repeats every 0.5 m across the width (UV.box s=0.5, tileable).

shotengai_lamp.name: shotengai_lamp
shotengai_lamp.desc: Shopping-street (商店街) lamp post ~5 m: globe lantern on top, two banner arms reaching over the kerb with a double-sided vertical banner (M_BannerFace, 0-1 UV each side, 0.45 x 1.2 m)
shotengai_lamp.front: banner arms reach toward the road (Unity +Z); banner faces Unity +-X
notes: Banner: two back-to-back quads on M_BannerFace, each 0-1 UV seen from its own side (aspect 0.48:1.17).

sidewalk_transformer_box.name: sidewalk_transformer_box
sidewalk_transformer_box.desc: Ground-mounted power distribution box (地上機器) on Tokyo pavements, 1.4 x 0.5 x 1.4 m

street_lamp_classic.name: street_lamp_classic
street_lamp_classic.desc: Classic Japanese bend-arm road light (ベンド形), galvanized tapered pole ~9 m, box luminaire with sodium bowl, base cover
street_lamp_classic.front: arm reaches toward the road, Unity +Z
notes: LightAnchor_0 = centre of the lamp bowl; aim a spot light straight down (-Y Unity).

street_lamp_led.name: street_lamp_led
street_lamp_led.desc: Modern Japanese LED road light: slim tapered pole ~8 m, tight bend into a short rising arm, flat LED luminaire
street_lamp_led.front: arm reaches toward the road, Unity +Z
notes: LightAnchor_0 = LED panel centre; aim a spot light straight down.

torii_stone.name: torii_stone
torii_stone.desc: Stone myōjin torii, 4.0 m to the kasagi top, inner span 2.6 m, plaque 山神社, shimenawa + shide

toro_stone_lantern.name: toro_stone_lantern
toro_stone_lantern.desc: Kasuga-style stone lantern (春日灯籠) 2.0 m: hex base, round pole, chūdai, hibukuro, curled roof, hōju

traffic_cone.name: traffic_cone
traffic_cone.desc: Japanese 700 mm traffic cone, red with white reflective bands

traffic_signal_pedestrian.name: traffic_signal_pedestrian
traffic_signal_pedestrian.desc: Japanese pedestrian signal: 3.6 m post, two stacked lamp boxes (red standing figure over green walking figure) with hoods, yellow push-button box
notes: Lamp faces use M_EmissiveSignal_PedRed / M_EmissiveSignal_PedGreen, both sampling the atlas prop_ped_signal_albedo.png (left half red standing, right half green walking).

traffic_signal_vehicle.name: traffic_signal_vehicle
traffic_signal_vehicle.desc: Japanese overhead vehicle signal: tapered steel pole, 5 m cantilever arm, horizontal 3-lamp head (green-yellow-red left to right as seen by the driver) with visors, intersection name plate
traffic_signal_vehicle.front: lamps face Unity +Z (toward approaching traffic); arm reaches Unity -X (Blender +X) over the road
notes: Each lamp has its own emissive material slot (M_EmissiveSignal_Green/Yellow/Red) so the game can switch lamps by swapping materials; empties Lamp_Green/Yellow/Red sit just in front of each lens. Name plate uses M_Deco_StreetName (0-1 UV, 2:1).

utility_pole_plain.name: utility_pole_plain
utility_pole_plain.desc: Japanese concrete distribution pole, 12 m above ground
utility_pole_plain.front: road side = Unity +Z; wires run along Unity X
notes: WireAnchor_0..2 = 6.6 kV phases (pin insulators, ~11.73 m), 3..5 = low-voltage spools (8.45/8.15/7.85 m, road side), 6 = telecom messenger (6.2 m, back side). Same indices on both variants; string catenaries between equal indices of neighbouring poles along Unity X.

utility_pole_transformer.name: utility_pole_transformer
utility_pole_transformer.desc: Japanese concrete distribution pole, 12 m above ground, pole-top transformer
utility_pole_transformer.front: road side = Unity +Z; wires run along Unity X
notes: WireAnchor_0..2 = 6.6 kV phases (pin insulators, ~11.73 m), 3..5 = low-voltage spools (8.45/8.15/7.85 m, road side), 6 = telecom messenger (6.2 m, back side). Same indices on both variants; string catenaries between equal indices of neighbouring poles along Unity X.

vending_machine_large.name: vending_machine_large
vending_machine_large.desc: Japanese drink vending machine 1.2 x 0.73 x 1.83 m; front face on M_VendingFront (0-1 UV)
notes: M_VendingFront: single quad, UV 0-1 = whole recessed face (u right, v up seen from the front, 1.12 x 1.56 m, aspect 0.718). 3D modules sit over the face: retrieval bin u 0.12-0.88 v 0.02-0.17; coin-return cup u 0.82-0.95 v 0.21-0.28; money panel u 0.81-0.96 v 0.45-0.63. LightAnchor_0: optional light 0.35 m in front of the face.

vending_machine_slim.name: vending_machine_slim
vending_machine_slim.desc: Japanese drink vending machine 0.8 x 0.73 x 1.83 m; front face on M_VendingFront (0-1 UV)
notes: M_VendingFront: single quad, UV 0-1 = whole recessed face (u right, v up seen from the front, 0.72 x 1.56 m, aspect 0.462). 3D modules sit over the face: retrieval bin u 0.11-0.89 v 0.02-0.17; coin-return cup u 0.72-0.92 v 0.21-0.28; money panel u 0.71-0.94 v 0.45-0.63. LightAnchor_0: optional light 0.35 m in front of the face.

vending_recycle_bin.name: vending_recycle_bin
vending_recycle_bin.desc: Can/PET bottle recycle box placed beside vending machines

crash_cushion.name: crash_cushion
crash_cushion.desc: Gore-point crash cushion (impact attenuator), 4.6 m, overlapping steel fender bays, striped nose
crash_cushion.origin: ground under the rear backstop centre
notes: Nose (yellow/black M_Deco_HazardStripe) at Unity Z ~ +4.5; backstop at origin. Place in gore areas with the nose toward approaching traffic.

emergency_phone_box.name: emergency_phone_box
emergency_phone_box.desc: Expressway emergency telephone (非常電話) cabinet on a pedestal with a green sign plate

jersey_barrier_2m.name: jersey_barrier_2m
jersey_barrier_2m.desc: Precast concrete New Jersey barrier, 2 m tile (810 tall, 610 base, 150 top)
jersey_barrier_2m.origin: ground, barrier centre line, tile start (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..2
notes: Symmetric profile (either side can face traffic). Steel connector loops protrude ~7 cm past both ends and interleave with the neighbouring tile.

overhead_sign_gantry.name: overhead_sign_gantry
overhead_sign_gantry.desc: Expressway portal sign gantry, 15 m span (3 lanes + shoulders), box truss, 8 x 2.8 m guide sign
overhead_sign_gantry.front: sign face Unity +Z (traffic approaches heading Unity -Z); span along Unity X
notes: M_SignFace: main panel 8.0 x 2.8 m (bottom 5.2 m), 0-1 UV, texture aspect 2.86:1. M_SignFace_Aux: 3.2 x 2.0 m panel (aspect 1.6:1). LightAnchor_0..3 = sign-lighting fixtures aimed up at the face.

shuto_light_pole.name: shuto_light_pole
shuto_light_pole.desc: Twin-arm (Y-type) expressway road light, ~10 m, sodium luminaires reaching over both carriageways
shuto_light_pole.origin: bottom of the base plate (mount on median/parapet top)
notes: LightAnchor_0/1 at the sodium emitter centres (~9.78 m); aim spot lights straight down (-Unity Y).

shuto_parapet_4m.name: shuto_parapet_4m
shuto_parapet_4m.desc: Shuto concrete wall parapet (壁高欄) 1.1 m + 4 m translucent sound barrier on H-posts every 2 m
shuto_parapet_4m.origin: deck level at the traffic-face toe, tile start (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..4; wall body extends to Unity -Z (away from traffic)
notes: Sound barrier: aluminium louvre band 1.13-1.63 m, translucent panels to 3.35 m, inclined top section (35 deg toward traffic) to ~3.95 m; H-posts at Unity X=0 and 2.
Concrete wall: 1.10 m tall, base 0.45, top 0.25, F-shape traffic face; 2.4 cm sealant joint at tile ends.

shuto_parapet_4m_nobarrier.name: shuto_parapet_4m_nobarrier
shuto_parapet_4m_nobarrier.desc: Shuto concrete wall parapet (壁高欄) 1.1 m
shuto_parapet_4m_nobarrier.origin: deck level at the traffic-face toe, tile start (Unity X=0); tile spans Unity X 0..4; wall body extends to Unity -Z (away from traffic)
notes: Concrete wall: 1.10 m tall, base 0.45, top 0.25, F-shape traffic face; 2.4 cm sealant joint at tile ends.

shuto_pier.name: shuto_pier
shuto_pier.desc: Shuto Expressway T-shaped RC pier: 2.4 x 3.0 m chamfered column, 16 m cap beam, top at 12.0 m
shuto_pier.front: cap beam spans Unity Z (across the deck); deck runs along Unity X
notes: Top of cap beam at 12.0 m; bearing sole plates top at 12.34 m (girder seat). Cap spans Unity Z -8..8.

tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_led.name: tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_led
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_led.desc: Tunnel wall lighting tile, 4 m: cable raceway + 2 LED fixtures
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_led.origin: wall plane at the raceway centre, tile start (Unity X=0); fixtures project toward Unity +Z
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_led.front: light faces Unity +Z, tilted 30 deg down
notes: Mount on the tunnel wall at ~4.5-5 m; LightAnchor_0/1 at emitter centres (fixtures at Unity X=1 and 3).

tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_sodium.name: tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_sodium
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_sodium.desc: Tunnel wall lighting tile, 4 m: cable raceway + 2 sodium fixtures
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_sodium.origin: wall plane at the raceway centre, tile start (Unity X=0); fixtures project toward Unity +Z
tunnel_lamp_strip_4m_sodium.front: light faces Unity +Z, tilted 30 deg down
notes: Mount on the tunnel wall at ~4.5-5 m; LightAnchor_0/1 at emitter centres (fixtures at Unity X=1 and 3).

bridge_end_post.name: bridge_end_post
bridge_end_post.desc: 親柱 bridge end pillar, granite 0.45 x 0.45, 1.25 m, cast bronze name plates (kanji 峠沢橋 faces Unity +Z, hiragana とうげさわばし faces Unity -X)

chevron_board_wide.name: chevron_board_wide
chevron_board_wide.desc: Wide chevron board (1.2 x 0.45 m, three chevrons) on two galvanized posts

chevron_curve_sign.name: chevron_curve_sign
chevron_curve_sign.desc: Yellow/black chevron curve-alignment panel (矢印板) 0.45 x 0.6 m on a galvanized post
chevron_curve_sign.front: face Unity +Z (chevron points to Unity -X; rotate 180 about Y or use the other side of the road for the opposite curve)
notes: M_Deco_Chevron face (texture prop_chevron_albedo.png) mapped 0-1; chevron points to the viewer's right.

delineator_post.name: delineator_post
delineator_post.desc: 視線誘導標: white Φ60.5 post with Φ100 round reflector (amber faces Unity -X, white faces +X)

mountain_guardrail_cable.name: mountain_guardrail_cable
mountain_guardrail_cable.desc: Japanese guard cable (ガードケーブル) tile, 4 m, white Φ114 posts, 5 x Φ18 cables, spacer bar
mountain_guardrail_cable.origin: ground at the post centre (Unity X=0); tile spans X 0..4
notes: Post at Unity X=0 only; cap a run with mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish at X=4N and mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start at X=0 (its heavier post encloses the tile post).

mountain_guardrail_cable_brown.name: mountain_guardrail_cable_brown
mountain_guardrail_cable_brown.desc: Japanese guard cable (ガードケーブル) tile, 4 m, brown (national-park) Φ114 posts, 5 x Φ18 cables, spacer bar
mountain_guardrail_cable_brown.origin: ground at the post centre (Unity X=0); tile spans X 0..4
notes: Post at Unity X=0 only; cap a run with mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish at X=4N and mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start at X=0 (its heavier post encloses the tile post).

mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish.name: mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish
mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish.desc: Guard cable end/anchor post (端末支柱) Φ165 with brace, footing and cable turnbuckles
mountain_guardrail_cable_end_finish.origin: ground at the end post centre (attach at the run end, Unity X=4N for _finish, X=0 for _start)

mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start.name: mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start
mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start.desc: Guard cable end/anchor post (端末支柱) Φ165 with brace, footing and cable turnbuckles
mountain_guardrail_cable_end_start.origin: ground at the end post centre (attach at the run end, Unity X=4N for _finish, X=0 for _start)

slope_protection_grid_wall_grass.name: slope_protection_grid_wall_grass
slope_protection_grid_wall_grass.desc: 法面 吹付法枠: concrete lattice frame on a 1:0.5 cut slope, 8 m wide x 6 m high tile, cells on M_SlopeFill_Grass
slope_protection_grid_wall_grass.origin: ground at the front-bottom edge of the toe, tile start (Unity X=0); tile spans X 0..8
slope_protection_grid_wall_grass.front: slope faces Unity +Z (road), leans back toward -Z
notes: Tile along Unity X every 8 m. Stack vertically with the next panel origin at Unity (0, +6.0, -3.5) (6 m up, 3.5 m back; its toe forms a 0.5 m berm).

slope_protection_grid_wall_shotcrete.name: slope_protection_grid_wall_shotcrete
slope_protection_grid_wall_shotcrete.desc: 法面 吹付法枠: concrete lattice frame on a 1:0.5 cut slope, 8 m wide x 6 m high tile, cells on M_SlopeFill_Shotcrete
slope_protection_grid_wall_shotcrete.origin: ground at the front-bottom edge of the toe, tile start (Unity X=0); tile spans X 0..8
slope_protection_grid_wall_shotcrete.front: slope faces Unity +Z (road), leans back toward -Z
